'''Toibu "Tobi" Lawal''' (born 1 May 2003)<ref name=birthday /> is a [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]] and for the [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]].

==Early life and high school==
Lawal attended [[Lee Academy (Maine)|Lee Academy]] located in [[Lee, Maine]]. Coming out of high school, he committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU Rams]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wilson |first1=Arrick |title=From across the pond: London native adapts to VCU basketball |url=https://commonwealthtimes.org/2022/11/09/from-across-the-pond-london-native-adapts-to-vcu-basketball/ |website=The Commonwealth Times |date=9 November 2022 |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

==College career==
=== VCU ===
As a [[freshman]] during the 2022-23 season, Lawal played sparingly, averaging 1.3 points per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Pearrell |first1=Tim |title=Springy VCU freshman Tobi Lawal ‘a threat vertically’ |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/schools/virginia-commonwealth-university/springy-vcu-freshman-tobi-lawal-a-threat-vertically/article_f5bc8294-b6e0-11ed-adf1-eba3066ac3b2.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> In the 2023-24 season, he played in 38 total games, averaging 7.7 points and 6.0 rebounds per game. After the conclusion of the season, Lawal entered the NCAA transfer portal.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wartooth |first1=Hokie |title=Hokies Add High-Flying VCU Transfer Toibu Lawal |url=https://247sports.com/college/virginia-tech/article/hokies-add-high-flying-vcu-transfer-toibu-lawal-230980036/ |website=247Sports |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref>

=== Virginia Tech ===
Lawal transferred to play for the [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech Hokies]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Joachim |first1=Zach |title=VCU hoops transfer portal updates: Fan favorite Lawal departs for Virginia Tech |url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/basketball/men/article_b2ed68f6-03fc-11ef-9359-d74115516bbc.html |website=Richmond Times-Dispatch |access-date=17 June 2026}}</ref> In his first season as a Hokie during the 2024-25 season, he started in 30 games, averaging 12.4 points and 7.0 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Hawkins |first1=Kenny |title=Virginia Tech men’s basketball player Tobi Lawal returns to the hokies |url=https://www.wjhl.com/sports/college-sports-2/virginia-tech-mens-basketball-player-tobi-lawal-returns-to-the-hokies/
